title.narrative: Seeds for the Future: Fostering socioeconomic empowerment of women in Upper Egypt through digital and green solutions - EU-Egypt Tamkeen

description.narrative: Contract related to: Seeds for the Future: Fostering socioeconomic empowerment of women in Upper Egypt through digital and green solutions - EU-Egypt Tamkeen - Women and girls¿ empowerment and their protection from gender-based violence is an important priority for the European Union and the Government of Egypt (GoE). Women and girls¿ empowerment are key priorities of existing national flagship programmes. Ongoing initiatives targeting women and girls¿ citizen rights and participation, financial inclusion and economic empowerment, and the protection from gender based violence are integrated into flagship programmes such as the `National Programme for the Development of the Egyptian Family¿ and the `Decent Life for Rural Development¿. Through a number of funded programmes over the past years, the European Union has been a key partner to Egypt in promoting and protecting the rights of women and girls. In line with the EU Egypt Partnership Priorities and with the EU Egypt Multi-Indicative Programme 2021-27 (MIP), the action aims at achieving an accelerated progress in gender equality and women and girls¿ empowerment. More specifically, the action aims at achieving the following three Specific Objectives: 1) Women and girls progress towards leadership positions and increased participation; 2) Women and girls have increased access to social and economic rights; and 3) Women and girls¿ exposure to risks of gender-based violence, including harmful practices, is reduced.
